results.check:
S2-0 [THE KERNEL] the Helmholtz filter's force ratio is
      S(r) = 1 - e^{-r/xi}(1 + r/xi) -> r^2/(2 xi^2) for r << xi

S2-1 [DEEP INSIDE] Saturn sits at r/xi ~ 1.5e-3, i.e. five orders of
      magnitude inside the screening length

S2-2 [THE GATE -- LOCAL READING] |Q2|/ceiling at Saturn, both footings,
      with the filter applied to the field that matter feels

S2-3 [THE SENSITIVITY -- GLOBAL READING, RECORDED NOT HIDDEN] if one
      instead weighted the phantom out to r_M ~ 8000 AU, the
      suppression would be only ~0.37 and the gate would FAIL

S3 [DISC GATE, SPOT-CHECK] the filter's correction at galactic radii is
      (xi/r)^2 ~ 1e-11 -- far below g02's 0.2% requirement, both footings
